summary.text: David Green, listed by Ballotpedia as S. David Green, is a Republican member of the West Virginia House of Delegates from District 36 and is seeking re-election against Democrat Katelynn Jordan in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An independent insurance agent, Green was appointed to the seat in January 2024.

paragraphs.text: David Green earned a bachelor's degree from Concord University, and his career experience includes working as an independent insurance agent.
Governor Jim Justice appointed Green to the House of Delegates on January 29, 2024, to replace Anita Hall.
